ev.q: eight human cases of WNV encephalitis were reported in Maryland (five) and New York (three); no deaths were reported
During 2001, 20 human cases of WNV encephalitis have been reported in New York (six), Maryland (five), Florida (four)
A total of 2521 crows and 952 other birds with WNV infection were reported from 23 states and the District of Columbia
West Nile virus (WNV) surveillance data reported to CDC through ArboNET and verified by states and other jurisdictions
